description: Returns where the user's requests stand: a fixed state, a next_action (send_request, respond_to_call_time, person_decides_on_website, join_call, wait or none), the call time in the user's own time zone and a link to the request page. With no task_id it lists the most recent requests. Read-only. It never returns text written by a developer. Prices, approvals and cards are never handled by this connector.

task_id.description: The request to look at. Leave it out to list the most recent ones.

name: get_task_status
title: See where a request stands
